qualifier: OXPHOS gene signature with complex III-IV electron transfer
name: Oxidative phosphorylation gene signature and respiratory chain electron transfer
rationale: All members concern mitochondrial electron transport and chemiosmotic ATP production; unlike its five-member twin it also carries the broad oxidative phosphorylation gene signature, and unlike other confusables it lacks respiratory complex assembly and mitochondrial translation.

core: Mitochondrial electron transfer and chemiosmotic ATP formation
qualifier: ubiquinol-to-oxygen segment (complexes III-IV)
name: Complex III-IV electron transfer and chemiosmotic ATP coupling
rationale: All members describe electron flow from ubiquinol through cytochrome c to oxygen and its coupling to ATP formation, without the oxidative phosphorylation gene signature of its superset twin or the complex assembly and mitochondrial translation of other confusables.

qualifier: core initiation-to-termination steps with ribosome quality control
name: Core mitochondrial transcription and translation steps with ribosome quality control
rationale: All members are mitochondrial transcription or translation steps plus mitoribosome quality control; unlike its superset twin it lacks mtDNA repair and maintenance, and unlike other confusables it lacks RNA processing, modification and tRNA aminoacylation.

qualifier: with mtDNA repair and maintenance
name: Mitochondrial genome maintenance, transcription and translation
rationale: All members concern expression of the mitochondrial genome from transcription through translation, and unlike its subset twin it adds mtDNA repair, regulation of mtDNA metabolism and small mitoribosome subunit assembly.

core: Neural progenitor proliferation and neuron differentiation
qualifier: neural stem cell maintenance and forebrain patterning
name: Neural stem cell maintenance, forebrain patterning and neuron differentiation
rationale: All members regulate neural progenitor proliferation and neuronal/glial differentiation, and unlike its twin the theme adds neural stem cell maintenance, forebrain dorsal/ventral patterning and morphogenesis, regulation of asymmetric division and adenohypophysis development.

core: Neural progenitor division and neural cell differentiation
qualifier: asymmetric neuroblast division, radial glia and neuron maturation
name: Asymmetric neuroblast division, radial glia differentiation and neuron maturation
rationale: All members concern neural progenitor division and differentiation of neurons and glia, and unlike its twin the theme adds asymmetric neuroblast division, forebrain radial glial differentiation, neuron maturation and retinal cell death rather than stem cell maintenance and forebrain patterning.

qualifier: tangential interneuron migration and cortical layering
name: Tangential interneuron migration and cortical layer formation
rationale: All members concern migration of neurons or their precursors and cortical/hippocampal layering, centred on tangential GABAergic and olfactory interneuron migration, without the axon tract morphogenesis, migration regulation or pyramidal neuron development of its superset confusables.

qualifier: forebrain commissure and axon tract formation
name: Cortical neuron migration, lamination and forebrain axon tract formation
rationale: All members concern forebrain/cortical neuron migration, specification and lamination, and unlike its confusables the theme adds anterior commissure, corpus callosum and corticospinal tract morphogenesis and radial glial differentiation.

qualifier: regulation of migration and forebrain neuron specification
name: Neuron migration regulation, forebrain neuron specification and cortical layering
rationale: All members concern neuronal migration and forebrain neuron development; unlike its subset twin it adds regulation of neuron migration, forebrain neuron commitment, pyramidal neuron and thalamus development, and unlike its superset it lacks axon tract morphogenesis.

qualifier: antibacterial and antifungal effector responses
name: Neutrophil antibacterial and antifungal killing via degranulation and ROS
rationale: All members concern neutrophil effector killing through degranulation, superoxide and respiratory burst against bacteria and fungi, without the macrophage/microglial phagocyte programme, mucus secretion or neutrophil activation brake of its superset twin.

qualifier: neutrophil plus tissue macrophage programme and mucus secretion
name: Neutrophil and tissue macrophage oxidative killing with mucus secretion
rationale: All members concern phagocyte respiratory burst, degranulation and microbial killing, and unlike its twin the theme adds the tissue macrophage/microglial NADPH oxidase programme, negative regulation of neutrophil activation and mucus secretion.

qualifier: TAK1-mediated JNK activation and its restraint
name: NOD1/2 bacterial sensing with TAK1-driven JNK activation
rationale: All members concern NOD1/2 and ALPK1 sensing of bacterial peptidoglycan and the TAK1-dependent JNK/p38 stress kinase output; unlike its superset twin it lacks positive p38 regulation and TNF signalling regulation.

core: NOD1/2 peptidoglycan sensing with stress kinase signalling
qualifier: bidirectional p38/SAPK control and TNF signalling
name: NOD1/2 sensing with bidirectional p38/JNK and TNF signalling control
rationale: All members concern NOD1/2 peptidoglycan sensing and the TAK1-driven stress kinase cascade, and unlike its subset twin the theme adds positive p38 regulation, negative SAPK regulation and positive regulation of TNF signalling.

qualifier: K63 ubiquitination and inflammasome receptor signalling
name: NOD1/2 signalling via K63 ubiquitination and inflammasome receptors
rationale: All members concern NOD-like receptor detection of peptidoglycan/muramyl dipeptide, and unlike its subset twin the theme adds the NOD1/2 signalling cascade, positive K63-linked ubiquitination and inflammasome receptor signalling.

qualifier: receptor-level regulation in muramyl dipeptide response
name: Muramyl dipeptide response and NOD receptor signalling regulation
rationale: All six members concern cellular responses to peptidoglycan/muramyl dipeptide and regulation of NOD1/NOD2 receptor signalling, without the downstream K63 ubiquitination, inflammasome or TAK1/MAPK steps present in its confusables.

qualifier: NFE2L2 target-gene classes and HIF-alpha oxygen sensing
name: NFE2L2 target-gene programmes and HIF-alpha oxygen sensing
rationale: All members concern NFE2L2 regulation and its target-gene classes or HIF-alpha hydroxylation and hypoxic gene expression, without the glycolysis, BACH1 and pentose-phosphate shunt regulation added by its superset twin.

qualifier: BACH1 control and glycolytic/pentose-phosphate metabolism
name: NRF2/BACH1 and HIF control of glycolytic and pentose-phosphate metabolism
rationale: All members concern NFE2L2 and HIF transcriptional programmes, and unlike its twin the theme adds BACH1 activity regulation, the glycolysis gene signature and regulation of the pentose-phosphate shunt.

qualifier: mitotic disassembly-reformation and inositol phosphate shuttling
name: Mitotic nuclear pore disassembly, reformation and inositol phosphate shuttling
rationale: All members concern the nuclear pore complex, its mitotic disassembly and postmitotic reassembly and its traffic of inositol phosphates and Rev; unlike its superset twin it lacks pore positioning, gene tethering and Rev-mediated HIV RNA export.

qualifier: pore positioning, gene tethering and Rev-mediated HIV RNA export
name: Nuclear pore positioning, gene tethering and Rev-mediated HIV RNA export
rationale: All members concern nuclear pore complex assembly and nucleocytoplasmic transit, and unlike its twin the theme adds nuclear pore localization, transcription-dependent gene tethering at the periphery and Rev-mediated export of HIV RNA.

qualifier: osmosensing with transepithelial chloride and renal sodium transport
name: Osmosensory signalling with transepithelial chloride and sodium transport
rationale: All five members concern sensing of hyper- and hypotonic stress and epithelial chloride/renal sodium transport, without the aldosterone, salt-stress, water homeostasis and renin-angiotensin members of its superset twin.

qualifier: aldosterone and salt-stress control of renal sodium handling
name: Salt stress, aldosterone response and renal sodium-water homeostasis
rationale: All members concern cellular and renal salt and water balance, and unlike its subset twin the theme adds aldosterone response, salt-stress responses, intracellular water homeostasis, sodium import regulation and renal renin-angiotensin blood pressure control.

qualifier: balance of osteoclast development and bone remodeling
name: Positive and negative control of osteoclast development and remodeling
rationale: All six members regulate osteoclast proliferation, differentiation, fusion and bone resorption/remodeling, without the DAP12 signalling and macrophage fusion/syncytium formation of its superset twin.

qualifier: DAP12 signalling and macrophage fusion into syncytia
name: DAP12 signalling and macrophage-to-osteoclast fusion into syncytia
rationale: All members concern osteoclast formation and bone resorption, and unlike its twin the theme adds DAP12 signalling, regulation of macrophage fusion, plasma membrane fusion and syncytium formation.

qualifier: peroxisome fission, omega-oxidation and NAD(P) cofactor supply
name: Peroxisomal lipid metabolism with fission, omega-oxidation and NAD(P) supply
rationale: All members concern peroxisomal fatty acid oxidation, elongation and ether lipid synthesis, and unlike its subset twin the theme adds peroxisome fission, fatty acid omega-oxidation, NAD transport, NADP+ synthesis and malonyl/succinyl-CoA metabolism.

qualifier: very-long-chain and branched-chain lipids and plasmalogens
name: Very-long-chain and branched fatty acid turnover with plasmalogen synthesis
rationale: All members concern peroxisomal alpha/beta-oxidation of very-long-chain and branched fatty acids, fatty acid elongation and plasmalogen/wax synthesis, without the peroxisome fission, omega-oxidation and NAD(P) cofactor members of its superset twin.
